title: 第19章 密林激战第20章 乞丐家主
lines: 他是打着前来送别林烬的由头而来，实则是准备看着各大势力翁蚌相争，
他好从中渔翁得利！
烈日将古道晒得发白，林战玄铁重剑插在滚烫的砂石中，
剑柄缠绕的镇魂铃无风自动。
他望着身后三十名亲卫结成的北斗天罡阵，
每个阵眼都悬浮着林家特有的赤炎符——这些符箓正在以肉眼可见的速度褪色。
还有三十里出炎城地界。
林烬攥紧马缰，焚天塔仿品在怀中发出灼人的震颤。
他能清晰感知到七道不同属性的灵力正在十里外交织，如同蛛网般向车队收拢。
林战突然抬手，亲卫们齐刷刷抽出腰间鸣镝箭。
箭头暗藏的炎爆符在阳光下泛着诡谲的紫光，
这是林家炼器堂特制的诛邪箭，每一支都足以轰平半座小山。
三息后东南巽位。
林战话音未落，前方百丈处的空气突然扭曲。
十八名蒙面人凭空现身，手中兵器却暴露了身份——
萧家暗卫独有的蛇形弯刀泛着青芒，刀刃上流转的正是萧家秘传青冥真气。
“交出那小子身上的小塔放你们一命！”
这时候，为首之人大声说道。
可是，等待他们的却是林战沉声低喝一声：
三十支诛邪箭撕裂长空，却在触及敌人的刹那诡异地悬停。
暗卫首领狞笑着扯下蒙面巾，露出萧家特有的蛇瞳：
林家主不会以为，我们连破符阵都没准备？
他手中青铜罗盘迸发幽光，竟是萧家大长老的天机盘仿品！
林烬突然感觉怀中仿品剧烈震动，塔尖自动指向罗盘。
两道青光自塔底激射而出，精准洞穿两名暗卫咽喉。
暗卫首领暴退数丈，惊骇发现罗盘表面出现蛛网状裂痕：
这不可能！
天机盘怎会被...
因为你们拿的是赝品。
林烬在马背上冷笑，暗金纹路自脖颈爬上耳后。
方才那瞬，他清晰感知到焚天塔仿品对天机盘的天然压制——就像猛虎遇见狸猫。
突然，西北方向传来诡异的铃铛声。
十二顶猩红轿子踏空而来，轿帘上绣着的合欢花正在渗血。
为首的轿夫掀开帘幕，露出柳媚半边腐烂的脸：
林家小子，你欠奴家之人两条命。
闻言，林烬心中暗自想道：
“看来，这柳媚是知道柳沐已经死在了我手中，
并且，当晚肯定还有其他人隐藏在暗处，
这样说来，柳沐身死的消息也是那人透露出去的。”
林烬想到这里，目光看了一眼炎城林浩所立之处，
眼中闪过一抹浓郁的杀意！
林战重剑横扫，剑气化作火凤扑向轿群。
content_en:
He came here under the guise of saying goodbye to Lin Jin, but in reality he was preparing to watch the major forces quarrel with each other.
He wants to profit from it!
The scorching sun turned the ancient road white, and Lin Zhan's black iron heavy sword was stuck in the hot sand and stone.
The soul-suppressing bell wrapped around the hilt of the sword automatically moves without wind.
He looked at the Beidou Tiangang Formation formed by thirty personal guards behind him.
Each array eye is suspended with the Lin family's unique red flame talismans - these talismans are fading at a speed visible to the naked eye.
There are still thirty miles to go out of Yancheng territory.
Lin Jin tightened his grip on the horse's reins, and the Burning Sky Tower replica made a scorching tremor in his arms.
He could clearly sense that seven spiritual powers of different attributes were intertwining ten miles away, closing in on the convoy like a spider web.
Lin Zhan suddenly raised his hand, and the guards all drew out the arrows from their waists.
The pyrotechnic symbol hidden in the arrow glows with an eerie purple light in the sunlight.
These are the evil-killing arrows specially made by the Lin Family Artifact Refining Hall. Each one is enough to flatten half a hill.
After three breaths, it will be in the southeastern Xun position.
Before Lin Zhan could finish his words, the air a hundred feet ahead suddenly distorted.
Eighteen masked men appeared out of thin air, but the weapons in their hands revealed their identities——
The unique snake-shaped scimitar of the Xiao family's secret guard glows with green light, and what flows on the blade is the Xiao family's secret Qing Ming Qi.
"Hand over the little tower on that kid and spare your lives!"
At this time, the leader said loudly.
However, what was waiting for them was Lin Zhan who shouted in a deep voice:
Thirty evil-killing arrows tore through the sky, but hovered strangely the moment they touched the enemy.
The leader of the secret guard pulled off his mask with a ferocious smile, revealing the Xiao family's unique snake eyes:
Doesn’t the head of the Lin family think that we are not even prepared to break the talisman formation?
The bronze compass in his hand burst out with a faint light, and it turned out to be a replica of the eldest elder of the Xiao family's celestial compass!
Lin Jin suddenly felt the imitation in his arms vibrate violently, and the top of the tower automatically pointed to the compass.
Two rays of green light shot out from the bottom of the tower, accurately piercing the throats of the two secret guards.
The leader of the secret guard retreated several feet and was horrified to find spider web-like cracks on the surface of the compass:
This is impossible!
How could the Tianji Disk be...
Because what you got is a fake.
Lin Jin sneered on the horse, dark gold lines creeping up from his neck to behind his ears.
At that moment, he clearly felt the natural suppression of the Tianji Disk by the imitation Burning Sky Tower - just like a tiger meeting a civet cat.
Suddenly, a strange bell sound came from the northwest.
Twelve scarlet sedans came through the air, and the albizia flowers embroidered on the sedan curtains were bleeding.
The leading bearer opened the curtain, revealing half of Liu Mei's rotten face:
Lin family boy, you owe two lives to the slave family.
Hearing this, Lin Jin thought to himself:
"It seems that Liu Mei knows that Liu Mu has died in my hands.
Moreover, there must have been others hiding in the dark that night,
In this way, the news of Liu Mu's death was also revealed by that person. "
Lin Jin thought of this and glanced at the place where Lin Hao stood in Yancheng.
A strong killing intent flashed in his eyes!
Lin Zhan's heavy sword swept across, and the sword energy turned into a fire phoenix and rushed towards the sedan chair group.
title_en: Chapter 19: Fierce Battle in the Jungle Chapter 20: The Beggar Family Head
